title: Determination of Structural Factors Contributing to Protection of Zinc Fingers in Estrogen Receptor alpha through Molecular Dynamic Simulations.
authors: Lutz, Patricia B; Coombs, Wesley R; Bayse, Craig A
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过微秒级分子动力学模拟研究雌激素受体α锌指结构域的结构动态，揭示ZF2灵活性及溶剂可及性对DNA结合与锌指保护机制的影响，属于TF-DNA互作机制的高匹配物理模拟研究。
abstract: The ERalpha transcription factor that induces tumor growth is a potential target for breast cancer treatment. Each monomer of the ERalpha DNA-binding domain (ERalphaDBD) homodimer has two conserved (Cys)(4)-type zinc fingers, ZF1 (N-terminal) and ZF2 (C-terminal). Electrophilic agents release Zn(2+) by oxidizing the coordinating Cys of the more labile ZF2 to inhibit dimerization and DNA binding. Microsecond-length molecular dynamics (MD) simulations show that greater flexibility of ZF2 in the ERalphaDBD monomer leaves its Cys more solvent accessible and less shielded from electrophilic attack by sulfur-centered hydrogen bonds than ZF1 which is buried in the protein. In the unreactive DNA-bound dimer, the formation of the dimer interface between the highly flexible D-box motif of ZF2 decreases the solvent accessibility of its Cys toward electrophiles and increases the populations of sulfur-containing hydrogen bonds that reduce their nucleophilicity. Examination of these factors in ERalphaDBD and other proteins with labile ZF motifs may reveal new targets to treat viral infections and cancer.
abstract_zh: 诱导肿瘤生长的ERalpha转录因子是乳腺癌治疗的潜在靶点。ERalpha DNA结合域（ERalphaDBD）同源二聚体的每个单体具有两个保守的（Cys）(4)型锌指，即ZF1（N端）和ZF2（C端）。亲电试剂通过氧化更不稳定的ZF2中配位Cys来释放Zn(2+)，从而抑制二聚化和DNA结合。微秒级分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟显示，ERalphaDBD单体中ZF2的更大灵活性使其Cys更易被溶剂接触，且受硫中心氢键对亲电攻击的屏蔽作用弱于埋在蛋白质内部的ZF1。在未反应的DNA结合二聚体中，ZF2高度灵活的D-box基序之间形成二聚界面，降低了其Cys对亲电试剂的溶剂可及性，并增加了含硫氢键的群体，从而降低其亲核性。在ERalphaDBD及其他具有不稳定ZF基序的蛋白质中考察这些因素，可能揭示治疗病毒感染和癌症的新靶点。
